svg.title: Figure 4: Reasoning-budget scaling across 6 models
svg.desc: Six small multiples showing UUID minus numeric accuracy across visible scratchpad budgets.
svg.text: Figure 4 — More scratchpad does not consistently repair UUID deficits across models
Final-answer accuracy delta (UUID minus numeric) across Pass 1 scratchpad budgets; paired 95% bootstrap intervals (5,760 model calls across 6 models).
UUID − numeric final-answer accuracy delta (percentage points)
Key finding: Across 6 architectures, increasing scratchpad capacity fails to erase UUID deficits; large penalties persist.
Includes both regimes: active scaling (Qwen 1.5B, Qwen 3.5 2B, Tiny Aya, Gemma E2B) and ceiling saturation (Gemma E4B, Qwen 3.5 4B).
